text: Mapei, founded in 1937 and based in Milan, describes itself on its own 'Mapei in Italy' page as 'a family business on an international scale': Veronica and Marco, the third generation of the Squinzi family, now head the company as Group CEOs. This page does not name the 1937 founder or address state or bank-foundation ownership.

source.name: Mapei S.p.A.: Mapei in Italy
source.quote: Veronica and Marco, the third generation of the Squinzi family, are continuing the family tradition by heading the company as CEOs of the Group and its Italian organisation.
